candidates.label: loopback default
candidates.fidelity: Bind behavior is modeled only; no interface was opened or probed.

candidates.label: Unix-domain transport
candidates.fidelity: Filesystem ownership, peer metadata, kernel enforcement and browser bridging are modeled assumptions.

candidates.label: authentication plus authorization
candidates.fidelity: Synthetic identity verifier and policy only; no external identity provider.

candidates.label: scoped capability
candidates.fidelity: Opaque in-memory labels model capability lifecycle; cryptography is not evaluated.

candidates.label: route separation
candidates.fidelity: Route partitions are in-process data structures; separation does not identify callers.

candidates.label: process separation
candidates.fidelity: Broker/worker is an in-process adapter; OS confinement and IPC behavior are not established.

candidates.label: loopback plus authentication/authorization
candidates.fidelity: Locality and identity policy are modeled; no network or external identity provider.

candidates.label: Unix-domain transport plus capability
candidates.fidelity: Transport and capability cryptography are modeled, not kernel- or provider-validated.

candidates.label: loopback plus authz, route separation and broker
candidates.fidelity: All boundaries are disposable in-process adapters; OS isolation is not established.

excludedCombinations: All non-COM-01..03 combinations remain excluded by the approved plan; none were added during collection.

scoringRubric.rule: No aggregate preference score and no mechanism selection. Hard gates are reported independently; trade-offs remain descriptive.
